name: Jichi
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Jichi, the Bolivian guardian serpent of waters.
ANATOMY: ONE enormous continuous SERPENT body with ONE HORSE HEAD, two horse ears, two eyes, flowing wet horse mane, NO legs, NO arms, NO wings or horns; scales below horse neck. [jichi-c02,jichi-c08]
MOMENT: Rise from river at sunset, horse head bends toward viewer, huge serpent coils lift sheets of ordinary displaced water.
POWER: Guardian emerging from water, no invented water-control beams; massive body physically displaces river into waves. [jichi-c02,jichi-c03]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle, subject fills80% of square; natural scale unless giant explicitly documented. Important features clear at200pixels.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant warm moonbreak/sunset or documented lantern, dramatic rim light, deep walnut shadows, natural moisture/dust.
SURFACE: tactile natural skin/fur/scales/wood where appropriate, opaque coarse textiles, rough stone, original visible painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Lowland Bolivia river with forest and waterfall at sunset only. [jichi-c01,jichi-c02,jichi-c03]
MOOD: dangerous for hostile beings, awe-inspiring and respectful for gods, guardians and living traditions, never cute/calm/decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text/lettering/logo/border/frame/watermark; no extra heads/limbs/fingers; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outlines, energy ribbons, floating runes.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px and head crop. One horse head (two upright ears, two eyes, white blaze, flared nostrils, long wet black mane) joins a continuous scaled serpent neck and body, whose giant coils break the river surface in several loops behind and around it (enormous serpent with a horse's head, jichi-c02/c08). No legs, wings or horns. The coils physically throw up sheets of river water. Sunset only (c03), with lowland forest and a waterfall (c02). The head bends down toward the viewer and the hybrid fills the frame. It reads clearly at 200px as a giant water guardian, not an ordinary horse. Warm low light, no aura, text or borrowed design.
